jobs.title: Senior HR Generalist
jobs.description:
At d-Matrix, we are focused on unleashing the potential of generative AI to power the transformation of technology. We are at the forefront of software and hardware innovation, pushing the boundaries of what is possible. Our culture is one of respect and collaboration.

We value humility and believe in direct communication. Our team is inclusive, and our differing perspectives allow for better solutions. We are seeking individuals passionate about tackling challenges and are driven by execution.  Ready to come find your playground? Together, we can help shape the endless possibilities of AI. 

 

Role Overview

d-Matrix is looking for a Senior HR Generalist with deep compensation and data expertise to help us make sound, defensible pay decisions in a highly competitive market for AI and technical talent. This is an individual contributor role that will own the analytical backbone of our compensation and people data — market benchmarking, salary structures, internal equity, and merit/bonus modeling — while also supporting broader People Operations. This is a hands-on generalist role rather than a pure Total Rewards specialist position: you'll bring real analytical depth to compensation and reporting and flex into core HR ops work as needed, with complex executive and sales compensation design handled by specialized outside expertise. You'll partner closely with HRBPs, Business Leaders, Talent Acquisition, Global Mobility and Immigration, Employee Relations, and Legal to deliver efficient, data-informed HR service.

What You Will Do

 - Lead market benchmarking and survey data analysis to keep salary ranges and job structures competitive and defensible.

 - Own job matching and leveling, ensuring consistency and internal equity across the organization.

 - Build and maintain compensation models for merit cycles, bonus pools, and promotions, translating data into clear, sound recommendations.

 - Support offer construction and internal equity analysis for new hires, promotions, and internal moves, including equity compensation.

 - Build and maintain HR reporting and dashboards (e.g., headcount, comp analytics, turnover), using HR data to identify trends, risks, and process gaps.

 - Own core People Operations processes — onboarding, offboarding, employee records, HR documentation, payroll coordination, and benefits administration.

 - Serve as HR systems owner (ADP WFN, Ashby, Lattice), ensuring data accuracy and integrity, and supporting integrations, audits, and troubleshooting.

 - Partner cross-functionally on HR service delivery, and maintain HR policies, procedures, and SOPs in response to regulatory changes.

What You Will Bring

 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

 - 5+ years in HR Operations, with meaningful, hands-on compensation experience — not limited to participating in an annual comp cycle.

 - Direct experience with market benchmarking/survey data, salary structure design, job matching/leveling, internal equity analysis, and merit/bonus modeling.

 - Solid understanding of equity compensation.

 - Strong Excel and analytical skills, with the ability to build models rather than just interpret them.

 - Experience with HRIS/ATS systems (e.g., ADP WFN, Ashby) supporting data-driven people operations.

Equal Opportunity Employment Policy

d-Matrix is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcomed and empowered to do their best work. We hire the best talent for our teams, regardless of race, religion, color, age, disability, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, genetic information, marital status, national origin, political affiliation, or veteran status. Our focus is on hiring teammates with humble expertise, kindness, dedication and a willingness to embrace challenges and learn together every day.

d-Matrix does not accept resumes or candidate submissions from external agencies. We appreciate the interest and effort of recruitment firms, but we kindly request that individual interested in opportunities with d-Matrix apply directly through our official channels.  This approach allows us to streamline our hiring processes and maintain a consistent and fair evaluation of al applicants. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

jobs.title: HR Technology & Analytics Manager
jobs.description:
At d-Matrix, we are focused on unleashing the potential of generative AI to power the transformation of technology. We are at the forefront of software and hardware innovation, pushing the boundaries of what is possible. Our culture is one of respect and collaboration.

We value humility and believe in direct communication. Our team is inclusive, and our differing perspectives allow for better solutions. We are seeking individuals passionate about tackling challenges and are driven by execution.  Ready to come find your playground? Together, we can help shape the endless possibilities of AI. 



Role Overview

d-Matrix is building the next generation of AI inference technology, and scaling that ambition requires an equally forward-looking approach to how we build and run our People function. We're looking for an HR Technology & Analytics Manager to own the technology, data, and workflow foundation across People Operations, Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partnership, payroll, benefits, performance, and compensation. This is a hands-on role for someone who pairs deep HR technology expertise with strong analytical capability and a genuine interest in how automation and AI can improve how People teams work. You'll serve as the primary owner of HR technology strategy and administration, people data governance, and process optimization — partnering closely with the CHRO, People Operations, HRBPs, Talent Acquisition, Finance, and IT to build reliable systems and a trusted source of People data. You'll also play a key role in People-related M&A diligence and integration.

What You Will Do

 - Own and optimize the HR technology ecosystem — HRIS, talent acquisition, performance/talent management, benefits, retirement, and payroll-related integrations — including system configuration, data architecture, and permissions.

 - Assess the current HR technology environment, build a forward-looking roadmap, and lead requirements gathering, RFPs, vendor evaluation, and implementation when new systems are needed.

 - Map and redesign end-to-end People processes (recruiting-to-hire, onboarding, promotions, compensation changes, transfers, leaves, offboarding) to improve accuracy, speed, and the employee/manager experience.

 - Identify manual or error-prone processes and implement automation and practical AI applications across People operations, reporting, and workflows.

 - Establish data governance, controls, and recurring audit practices, translating data into insights and dashboards that support headcount, workforce, and organizational health decisions.

 - Own data standards and be hands-on in the systems — entering, correcting, and reconciling data during cleanup, implementation, or high-priority issue resolution.

 - Partner with People Operations and payroll providers to ensure accurate data flow into U.S. and international payroll, benefits, and retirement processes.

 - Lead HR technology, data, and systems integration workstreams for M&A, including assessing acquired-company systems and building repeatable integration processes.

What You Will Bring

 - 8+ years of progressive experience in HR technology, HRIS, People Operations, or People Analytics, with significant hands-on ownership of HR technology and employee data.

 - Demonstrated experience owning multiple HR technology platforms and the integrations/data flows between them.

 - Deep experience administering a major HRIS platform.

 - Strong People Analytics capability, with the ability to move from raw data to meaningful business insights.

 - Advanced Excel skills and strong overall data fluency.

 - Experience designing and improving HR workflows, approval processes, and automation.

 - Demonstrated ability to identify, investigate, and resolve complex data and systems issues.

 - Strong project management, communication, and cross-functional partnership skills.

 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience with ADP Workforce Now.

 - Experience supporting People-related M&A diligence, data migration, or integration.

 - Understanding of U.S. and international/global payroll, benefits, and retirement-plan data flows.

 - Experience in a high-growth, global technology environment.

 - Demonstrated experience applying AI and emerging technologies to improve HR processes and productivity.

Equal Opportunity Employment Policy

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcomed and empowered to do their best work. We hire the best talent for our teams, regardless of race, religion, color, age, disability, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, genetic information, marital status, national origin, political affiliation, or veteran status. jobs.title: Director of Sales
jobs.description:
At d-Matrix, we are focused on unleashing the potential of generative AI to power the transformation of technology. We are at the forefront of software and hardware innovation, pushing the boundaries of what is possible. Our culture is one of respect and collaboration.

We value humility and believe in direct communication. Our team is inclusive, and our differing perspectives allow for better solutions. We are seeking individuals passionate about tackling challenges and are driven by execution.  Ready to come find your playground? Together, we can help shape the endless possibilities of AI. 

Director of Sales
Location: Santa Clara, CA. Customer travel up to 40%.

Role Overview

d-Matrix is hiring a Director of Sales to drive revenue growth for our inference platform as Corsair moves into volume production. You'll own a portfolio of strategic accounts across hyperscalers, neoclouds, AI labs, and AI-native enterprises. You'll run the full sales cycle, from first technical engagement and proof-of-concept through multi-rack deployment commitments. You'll sell Corsair accelerators, JetStream networking, the Aviator software stack, and SquadRack rack-scale systems. You'll work closely with product, solutions engineers, operations, and ecosystem partners. You'll also help build the playbooks, processes, and team as our commercial organization scales.

What You Will Do

 - Own and grow a portfolio of strategic accounts, maintaining account plans, call cadences, and clear next steps on every active opportunity.

 - Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles for Corsair, JetStream, Aviator, and SquadRack. Engage infrastructure, platform, procurement, and executive stakeholders to qualify opportunities and build business cases.

 - Coordinate benchmarking, evaluations, and proof-of-concept deployments with solutions engineers, and convert them into production commitments.

 - Prepare proposals, quotes, pricing, and RFI/RFP responses with Finance and Product. Negotiate commercial terms, including volume pricing, supply allocation, delivery schedules, and support agreements.

 - Run weekly pipeline reviews and the quarterly forecast. Report bookings, revenue, deal health, and win/loss results to company leadership.

 - Partner with Operations and Supply Chain to align customer demand with production ramp and allocation. Work with ecosystem partners on joint go-to-market and co-selling.

 - Translate customer requirements and competitive insights into actionable product roadmap feedback.

 - Build sales playbooks, processes, and tools (e.g., CRM) as the team scales, and represent d-Matrix at industry events.

What You Will Bring

 - 8+ years of enterprise or strategic sales experience in data center infrastructure (semiconductors, AI accelerators, GPUs, servers, or networking), including 3+ years selling to hyperscale or cloud customers.

 - Track record of closing multi-million-dollar hardware and/or platform deals with long, technically complex sales cycles.

 - Established relationships with infrastructure and procurement decision-makers.

 - Technical fluency in AI infrastructure, including inference workloads, accelerator architectures, and data center power, cooling, and rack-level considerations.

 - Excellent communication, negotiation, and executive presence, with the ability to influence across customer and internal organizations.

 - Experience with CRM-driven pipeline management and disciplined forecasting.

 - Bachelor's degree in engineering, business, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience selling AI inference or training silicon.

 - Experience introducing a new architecture or product category into accounts with an established incumbent.

 - Experience working with system partners.

 - Experience at a growth-stage startup.

 - Existing network in the Seattle-area cloud ecosystem or the Bay Area.

Equal Opportunity Employment Policy

d-Matrix is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcomed and empowered to do their best work. We hire the best talent for our teams, regardless of race, religion, color, age, disability, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, genetic information, marital status, national origin, political affiliation, or veteran status.
